# nico_allocation (Data Source)

Allocations are the mechanism by which Provider can delegate Network and Compute resources to Tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_allocation" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "allocation_name" {
  value = data.nico_allocation.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allocation_id` (String) Path parameter: allocation_id.
- `constraint_type` (String) Filter Allocations by Constraint Type. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one Constraint Type.
- `constraint_value` (String) Filter Allocations by Constraint Value. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one Constraint Value.
- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) Filter Allocations by Infrastructure Provider ID.
- `query` (String) Search for matches across all Allocations. Input will be matched against name, description, and status fields
- `resource_type` (String) Filter Allocations by Constraint Resource Type. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one Constraint Resource Type.
- `resource_type_id` (String) Filter Allocations by Constraint Resource Type ID. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one Constraint Resource Type ID.
- `site_id` (String) Filter Allocations by Site ID. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one Site ID.
- `status` (String) Filter Allocations by Status. Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one Status.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter Allocations by Tenant ID.

### Read-Only

- `allocation_constraints` (Attributes List) List of Allocation Constraints for the Allocation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_constraints))
- `created` (String) Date/time when the Allocation was created
- `description` (String) Detailed description of the Allocation
- `name` (String) Concise and descriptive name of the Allocation
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the Allocation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Allocation was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--allocation_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_constraints`

Read-Only:

- `allocation_id` (String) ID of the Allocation that contains the Allocation Constraint
- `constraint_type` (String) Type of the Allocation Constraint. `Reserved` is the only constraint type supported by current implementation.
- `constraint_value` (Number) Value of the Allocation Constraint. For resource type: `InstanceType`, this value represents number of Machines associated with the Instance Type that is allocated to the Tenant. For resource type `IPBlock`, this value represents the prefix length of the IP Block allocated to the Tenant.
- `created` (String) Date/time when the Allocation Constraint was created
- `deprecations` (Attributes List) Deprecations active for this resource. Returned only if there are active deprecations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_constraints--deprecations))
- `derived_resource_id` (String) ID of the allocated Tenant IP Block when resource type is IPBlock
- `id` (String) ID of the Allocation Constraint
- `instance_type` (Attributes) Summary of the Instance Type (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_constraints--instance_type))
- `ip_block` (Attributes) Summary of the IP Block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_constraints--ip_block))
- `resource_type` (String) Type of the Resource that the Allocation Constraint applies to
- `resource_type_id` (String) ID of the resource that acts as the source of the Allocation. For resource type `InstanceType`, this is the ID of the Instance Type whose associated Machines are allocated to the Tenant. For resource type `IPBlock`, this is the ID of the Site-level IP Block from which a prefix is allocated to the Tenant.
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Allocation Constraint was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--allocation_constraints--deprecations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_constraints.deprecations`

Read-Only:

- `attribute` (String) Name of the attribute that is deprecated. Omitted if queryParam or endpoint is being deprecated.
- `endpoint` (String) API endpoint that is deprecated. Omitted if attribute or queryParam is being deprecated.
- `notice` (String) Message describing the deprecation
- `query_param` (String) Query parameter that is deprecated. Omitted if attribute or endpoint is being deprecated.
- `replaced_by` (String) Name of the attribute, query parameter, or endpoint that replaces the deprecated item. Omitted if no replacement is available.
- `take_action_by` (String) Date/time by which clients should migrate away from the deprecated API surface


<a id="nestedatt--allocation_constraints--instance_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_constraints.instance_type`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the Instance Type
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the Instance Type
- `name` (String) Name of the Instance Type, only lowercase characters, digits, hyphens and cannot begin/end with hyphen
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site that owns the Instance Type
- `status` (String) Status of the Instance Type


<a id="nestedatt--allocation_constraints--ip_block"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_constraints.ip_block`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the IP Block
- `name` (String) Name of the IP Block, only lowercase characters, digits, hyphens and cannot begin/end with hyphen
- `prefix` (String) Either IPv4 or IPv6 address
- `prefix_length` (Number) Min: 1, Max: 32 for ipv4, 128 for ipv6
- `routing_type` (String) RoutingType of the IP Block
- `status` (String) Status of the IP Block



<a id="nestedatt--status_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_history`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Date/time when the associated entity assumed the status
- `message` (String) Description of the state and cause/remedy in case of error
- `status` (String) State of the associated entity at a particular time
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the associated entity was last observed with this status
